dec.pe: Zimbabwean women married to foreign men found their husbands could not get residence. The Supreme Court said a woman’s right to live in her country includes living there with her husband.
dec.pi: Perempuan Zimbabwe yang menikah dengan pria asing mendapati suami mereka tidak bisa mendapat izin tinggal. MA menyatakan hak perempuan tinggal di negaranya termasuk tinggal bersama suaminya.

dec.n: Zimbabwe Lawyers for Human Rights and IHRDA (on behalf of Andrew Meldrum) v. Zimbabwe
dec.ct: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
dec.pe: A US journalist who had lived and worked in Zimbabwe for over 20 years was deported even though courts had ordered that he could stay. The African Commission found a breach.
dec.pi: Seorang wartawan AS yang tinggal dan bekerja di Zimbabwe lebih dari 20 tahun dideportasi padahal pengadilan sudah memerintahkan ia boleh tinggal. Komisi Afrika menemukan pelanggaran.
